# NextVector

> NextVector is an independent AI news site and model data hub. Stories use a three-question format (What happened? Why does it matter? What could happen next?). Model pages carry sourced data: arena.ai text scores, Artificial Analysis indexes (data: Artificial Analysis, https://artificialanalysis.ai), OSWorld-Verified and SWE-bench Verified results, list prices and context windows.

Editorial charter: Less noise. More signal. Sourced benchmarks over marketing claims. Founded and edited by Robiul Hasan (https://rhasan.online). Every story links its primary sources and gets a 1–100 Signal Rating (formula on the About page). NextVector does not run benchmarks itself: model numbers come from public leaderboards and vendor price pages, saved as dated copies. Model data checked 2026-11-12.

## Core Hubs
- [NextVector Home](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/): Latest AI news, newest first, with the lead story on top.
- [AI Models Directory](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/models): 146 tracked AI models with sourced list prices, context windows, licences and arena.ai text scores.
- [Model Showdowns & Comparisons](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/compare): Head-to-head comparisons built from the same data (arena.ai score, list price, context, licence).
- [AI Subscription Buyer's Guide](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/subscriptions): Plain-English guide to ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Google AI Pro, Cursor Pro and the $100-$200 plans, with budget options. Plan prices checked on vendor pages October 12, 2026.
- [Benchmark Leaderboards](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/benchmarks): arena.ai text, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, OSWorld-Verified (computer use), SWE-bench Verified (code, bash-only runs) and a price vs Arena score frontier.
- [AI Breakthrough Timeline](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/timeline): Chronological record of major AI and computing milestones.
- [Daily Intelligence Briefing](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/briefing): A short scan of the day's main AI stories.
- [Research Explained](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/research): Plain-language explanations of research papers.
- [Story Archive](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/archive): Crawlable list of every published story.

## Latest Stories
- [FAA Halts All U.S. Departing Flights After L3Harris Telecom Update Crash](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/faa-nationwide-ground-stop-l3harris-telecom-outage) (2026-11-14): An emergency ground stop at 20:54 UTC stranded an estimated 300,000 to 400,000 passengers after a software update triggered a crash across the network linking more than 4,400 aviation facilities.
- [Claude Helps Logicians Unlock 663 Theorems Inside Kurt Gödel’s Shorthand Notebooks](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/ai-deciphers-kurt-godel-shorthand-notebooks-coq-theorems) (2026-11-14): Helsinki University’s Jan von Plato fed 1,009 pages of obsolete Gabelsberger shorthand transcriptions to Anthropic’s AI, verifying roughly 400 results in the Coq proof assistant.
- [OpenAI Disbands Stand-Alone Robotics Team as General Model GPT-6 Astra Controls Robots Directly](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/openai-disbands-robotics-team-gpt-6-astra-embodied-ai) (2026-11-13): Researchers moved under CRO Mark Chen and President Greg Brockman after an Nvidia simulation study showed Astra hitting 74.8% manipulation success versus 51.0% for specialist robot models.
- [OpenAI and Google Launch Wallet Connections for AI Agents on the Same Day](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/openai-chatgpt-wallet-google-wallet-gemini-launch) (2026-11-13): ChatGPT Wallet enables tokenized checkout via Amex, Mastercard, and Visa for U.S. Pro subscribers, while Google Wallet adds read-only Plaid financial analysis inside Gemini.
- [Microsoft 365 Global Outage Past 24 Hours Halts Courts, Hospitals, and Rail Networks](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/microsoft-365-24-hour-global-outage-multi-cloud-debate) (2026-11-13): A network capacity upgrade triggered cascading Exchange Online and health-check failures affecting more than 70 countries across Microsoft's 430 million-user base.

## Editorial Standards
- [About NextVector & Robiul Hasan](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/about): Founder background, editorial principles and the 1–100 Signal Rating formula.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/faq): Answers on AI models, where our data comes from and how Signal Ratings work.
- [Contact](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/contact): Editorial contact, corrections and benchmark submissions.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [XML Sitemap](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/sitemap.xml): Every published story, model and hub page.
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/rss.xml): The 60 newest stories.
- [Full Text for LLMs](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/llms-full.txt): Every story in full plus the complete model directory with sources.
- [Machine AI Summary](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/ai-summary.json): Site facts, endpoints and current model picks as JSON.
